title: The Role of Agentic Instruction Categories for Code Generation: A Study of Five Python Libraries
abstract: arXiv:2610.21421v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic coding systems increasingly rely on repository-level agent files, such as AGENTS.md, to communicate project knowledge and developer intent. However, it remains unclear which categories of agent instructions enable efficient agent-file generation and accurate code generation. We evaluate five instruction categories: Repository Overview, Function Description, Implementation Detail, Testing, and Reconstruction Steps, across all 31 non-empty combinations using two Large Language Models (LLMs), Gemma 4 and GPT-5.4, and five human-written Python libraries. Our study addresses two research questions, comprising five sub-questions, on agent file generation and code generation. Results show that the number of instructions alone does not determine token usage for agent-file generation, with substantial variation across models and libraries. Although most AI-generated libraries compiled successfully regardless of the instruction combination

translated_title: 代理式指令类别在代码生成中的作用：五个人工智能Python库的研究
translated_abstract: 代理式编码系统日益依赖仓库级的代理文件（如AGENTS.md）来传递项目知识和开发者意图。然而，目前尚不清楚哪些类别的代理指令能够实现高效的代理文件生成和准确的代码生成。我们使用两个大语言模型（LLM）——Gemma 4和GPT-5.4，以及五个人类编写的Python库，评估了五类指令：仓库概述、函数描述、实现细节、测试和重构步骤，涵盖了所有31种非空组合。我们的研究围绕代理文件生成和代码生成提出了两个研究问题（包含五个子问题）。结果表明，仅凭指令数量并不能决定代理文件生成的token使用量，且不同模型和库之间存在显著差异。尽管无论采用哪种指令组合，大多数AI生成的库都能成功编译……
tldr: 该研究利用两个大语言模型和五个Python库系统评估了五类代理指令的全部31种组合，发现指令数量本身并不能决定代理文件生成的token消耗，且不同模型和库之间的表现差异显著。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates all 31 non-empty combinations of five agent instruction categories using two LLMs and five Python libraries, finding that the number of instructions alone does not determine token usage for agent-file generation, with substantial variation across models and libraries.
